title: The Biggest Land Animal Flees From the Sound of Bees
subject: African elephant

scenes.text: The biggest land animal on Earth runs from a buzz.
Researchers played bee sounds to elephant families.
Six of ten families fled. Only two fled from a normal elephant rumble.
They also make a special rumble, and shake their heads, when they flee bees.
Bees are tiny, but a swarm is a threat even to a giant.
Farmers now fence crops with beehives to keep elephants out.

description:
The biggest land animal on Earth runs from a buzz.
In a study, 6 of 10 elephant families fled a recording of bees, and they use a special rumble to warn each other.
Would you have guessed that elephants fear bees?
